dict.string: iAgent uses the microphone to transcribe prompts, local notes, and meetings you explicitly start recording.
iAgent records screen and system audio only when you explicitly start a meeting recording, so it can transcribe the call into a local note.
iAgent captures system audio only during a meeting recording you explicitly start, so remote participants can be included in the local transcript.
iAgent reads today’s Apple Calendar events to build your private daily briefing.
iAgent uses Contacts only to show names for message participants you sync from this Mac.
iAgent reads saved meeting links from today’s Apple Calendar events so you can join them from the panel.
iAgent uses speech recognition to turn live dictation and meetings you explicitly record into local notes.
